data_a.site: Bellhouse Yard workroom and Ardhu Lane annexe
data_a.situation: The workroom cannot finish the whole Marchmont Enclosure top-up by the date the client asked for, and the coordinator is telling the workroom manager where it actually stands.
known_facts: Marchmont Enclosure asked for 14 finished pieces by Thursday 9 October at 16:00.
Nine narrow-brim pieces need one steam cycle each; the five wide-brim pieces need two cycles each.
One press in the Ardhu Lane annexe is free before Thursday; the second press is committed to QM-2031-0461 until Thursday at 12:00.
Friday 10 October morning is clear on both presses.
The coordinator has given Marchmont Enclosure no date of any kind.
constraints: Dates given to Marchmont Enclosure are given by the workroom manager or the commercial lead, not by the coordinator.
Re-sequencing the workroom's own finishing order is the coordinator's decision.

turns.input_raw:
Review this for me before I send it to Marit, please.
